displayIdentity.body: Paul divides the council around resurrection hope. Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.” The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”
displayIdentity.title: Paul divides the council around resurrection hope
